THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
NIGHT & LIFESTYLE
164
STUDY 133
Black One-Shoulder Top & Lace Pants
Rights check
Source: 25019.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, loose brown hair
wears clear-framed glasses. She wears a black
one-shoulder cropped top and a black stretch mini skirt,
with flared lace-overlay trousers. Her expression is
calm and direct. A bright closet with clothing on a rack
and a white door behind her. Soft, even indoor light.
Palette of black, white, and warm neutral skin tones.
Sleek and minimal, in the style of a streetwear outfit
lookbook.
Sleek, minimal, bold
WORKING NOTES
- The lace overlay and one-shoulder top are the key
pieces.
- Keep the closet background for a casual, at-home look.
